description: The Porsche 356 (1948-1965) was the first Porsche, built by Ferry Porsche using Volkswagen Beetle components. Its evolution through Pre-A, A, B, and C series laid every engineering principle that the 911 would inherit — rear-engine layout, torsion bar suspension, and a philosophy of continuous refinement over revolution.
